workload: context 4, 80 decode tokens, per-token curve, 32 GiB cache budget, verify_hash=true
change: Memoize decoded native tensors so each is read, widened and SHA-256 verified once per process instead of on every access.

integrity_held.claim: Verification still happens, exactly once per tensor.
pinned_by_tests: repeated dense on the same tensor -> verifications stays 1
integrity_held.why_this_mattered: A fix that simply stopped verifying would have produced the same number and failed the gate. The defect was the same bytes re-hashed thousands of times per run, not that hashing is wrong.

residency_unchanged.note: Identical to the pre-fix run, confirming this is a CPU-side verification change and not a residency change.

gate_standing.root_cause_of_the_remainder: ~1,171 CPU-to-GPU synchronizations per token; see HAWKING_BASE_RUNTIME_ROOT_CAUSE.json

not_evidence_of: any acceleration; this is unaccelerated batch-1 decode
